name: Ring Chest Fly
steps: Set gymnastic rings low near the floor and support yourself in a high plank with straight arms and palms facing inward.
Brace your abs and glutes tightly while holding a slight, fixed soft bend in both elbows.
Open your arms smoothly out to the sides to lower your chest between the rings until you feel a firm pectoral stretch.
Squeeze your chest hard to sweep the rings smoothly back together beneath your shoulders.
tips: Raise the rings higher to reduce leverage until you can control the full range without sagging at the hips.
Keep your elbows softly bent at the same angle rather than turning the fly into a push-up.
